prompt: An anime illustration depicts a vibrant primary school classroom filled with energy and color. In the center foreground, a teacher with short brown hair and glasses holds a large picture book open, showing it to three students seated on colorful rugs. To the left, a boy with spiky black hair raises his hand eagerly, wearing a blue uniform shirt. Next to him, a girl with pink pigtails leans forward, resting her chin on her hands as she gazes at the book. On the right side of the room, two students work together at a low table; one pours glue from a bottle while the other holds a piece of construction paper steady. A fluffy white cat sits on the windowsill in the background, watching the class with wide eyes. Near the back wall, a student carries a stack of books toward a shelf, balancing them carefully. Another child kneels near a plant pot, watering a small fern with a tiny watering can. Sunlight streams through large windows, illuminating dust motes in the air and casting soft glows on the wooden desks. The walls are decorated with colorful drawings and alphabet charts. The style features clean lines, expressive eyes, and saturated pastel colors typical of modern anime aesthetics.
